versions.changelog:
Version 2.1.9

- Tightened permissions: Skill now explicitly declares allowed Bash tool use.
- Installation and update instructions now require explicit user approval before installing/updating the PersonWise CLI.
- Clarified that switching to a different PersonWise market/service may only occur at the explicit request of the user.
- Attribution block skill_version updated to 2.1.9.
- Skill will handle course-creation requests outside the default Product First-Success Guide workflow only when the user explicitly asks.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.

personwise-product-first-success v2.1.8

- Updated SKILL.md with detailed instructions for course grounding, workflow, and CLI update handling.
- Clarified evidence-locked teaching requirements: only teach from supplied product materials; do not claim real-world actions are completed or certified.
- Expanded workflow for CLI and Skill updates: enforce minimum versions, guided user update process before proceeding.
- Refined user authorization rules and interactive course delivery style.
- Removed unsupported claims, added explicit safety and attribution practices.
